title: Gateway Guardians
blurb: The citadel sits atop a barren cliff. Jutting from the black rock like some wart on the landscape, it is a short, flat-topped thing, with a wide base and a small, squat second story. The surrounding land is empty and…

title: Hall of Mosaics
blurb: This large hallway measures 20 feet by 50 feet and ends at another large door. The walls are completely tiled with mosaics illustrating the deeds of a great, green-robed sorcerer.

title: Empty Secrets
blurb: These side hallways are empty. They are dusty, with relatively recent footprints (of a man in a robe) on the floor. The prints lead from the secret entrances to the peepholes at the ends.

title: Foyer
blurb: This 40-foot by 30-foot room is appointed as a living room or reception area. Couches, chairs, and tables are arranged to create several comfortable seating areas. Lush rugs cover the stone floors, and colorful…

title: Hall of Anguish
blurb: Unlike previous passages, the walls, floor, and ceiling of this 100-foot by 10-foot hallway are a pebbled, dark gray tone, made of some stone you're not familiar with. A faint sense of motion is evident in the walls,…

title: Passageway
blurb: A burly emerald soldier stands guard over this hall. He is remarkably lifelike, down to his curly hair and pockmarked skin. He looks in your direction, hefts his emerald axe, and strides toward you.

title: Passageway, Continued
blurb: The secret door is a hinged stone panel that swings in both directions (pushing hard on the wall reveals it). It allows the emerald enchanter to pass without triggering the pit trap, which opens when 50 lbs. or more…

title: Library
blurb: This room appears to be a library. There are eight bookstands, two of them supporting massive metal-bound tomes. Various reading chairs occupy the center of the room.

title: Bedroom
blurb: This 15-foot by 20-foot space appears to be a sparsely appointed bedroom. There is a small, untidy bed, a dresser, a chair, a stool, and a shelf.

title: Lounge
blurb: This comfortably appointed lounge area has an upholstered sofa, several chairs, and a table. The walls are decorated with framed drawings of various men and women.

title: Guard Station
blurb: You enter a wide hallway, but before you can take it in you must raise your weapons to defend against a charging emerald man!

title: Barracks
blurb: This 10-foot by 15-foot room has a table and two chairs. There are various blunted weapons strewn about, as well as rags and buckets of what appears to be polish.

title: Consultorium
blurb: This 20-foot by 20-foot room is dark and unlit. Thick carpeting covers the floor and heavy velvet curtains hang from the walls. Three grotesque objects are arranged throughout the room. Opposite you, a pale human…

title: The Menagerie
blurb: The hallway straightens. Ahead, you see stout iron bars set into the wall on either side, clearly designed to restrain something powerful. Harsh sniffing and scratching sounds come from behind the bars.

title: Door Opener
blurb: **Party of 3:** No stat changes needed to the cells themselves (ruby cats, topaz serpent, alien creature) — each is a separate, single threat, so it's already roughly 1-for-1 with a 3-person party. The real risk here…

title: Vat Fodder
blurb: This 20-foot by 20-foot room is filled with four barred cells. Inside the cells are villagers! At the sight of you, they jump to their feet and beg to be saved.

title: Skull Trap
blurb: This wide room is dominated by a massive carving of a skull inscribed into the northern wall. Its eyes are painted red and its teeth painted green. Otherwise the room is empty.

title: Hand Hive
blurb: This open hallway is clean and spare—except for the dirty brown webbing on the far walls.

title: Kitchen
blurb: This area is clearly a kitchen. There are two wood-fired stoves, many pots and kettles, a large cauldron, and shelving with food and supplies.

title: Laboratory
blurb: This room is a jumbled mess of tables, vials, beakers, powders, hoses, shelves, and mechanical contraptions. Despite the mess, your eyes are drawn to something you cannot look away from. In the center of the room, a…

title: Storage
blurb: This cluttered room is piled high with sacks, crates, and tools.

title: Unholy Gardens
blurb: You open this door and catch a glimpse of a lush garden—but are immediately distracted by an enormous emerald ogre-thing rushing to attack you!

title: Tunnels
blurb: These dark tunnels are carved from solid rock. The floor and walls are uneven and pitch black beyond the reach of your sight.

title: Tunnels
blurb: These dark tunnels are carved from solid rock. The floor and walls are uneven and pitch black beyond the reach of your sight.

title: The Moon-Devil's Dungeon
blurb: This irregular cavern has a shadowed ceiling hidden behind stalactites. The pock-marked walls hold deep pools of darkness, making the exact dimensions of the room hard to identify. In the exact center of the room is…

title: The Tunnel Up
blurb: This corridor ends in another vertical chimney leading straight up. A hint of light can be seen through what appears to be a distant grate. A series of brass tubes emerge from the dirt under the chimney and rise up…

title: Guard Station
blurb: Rounding the corner, you see a small chamber with a door on the far wall. Another emerald statue confronts you, this one more horrible than the last. It is a hulking 8-foot-tall humanoid with enormous hooked claws at…

title: Observatorium
blurb: This large room is dominated by an enormous crystal ball set into the ceiling in the far corner. In the opposite corner, closest to you, is a flat emerald tabletop, much like the one you saw earlier in your…

title: Carving Station
blurb: This room looks like a sculptor's workshop. There are several large slabs of emerald, all with half-formed shapes carved from them. Most are humanoid torsos, though some resemble other shapes—one is like a miniature…

title: Resting Station
blurb: This room is a comfortable-looking bedroom. There is a bed with a thick straw mattress, a bookshelf with several dusty volumes, a chair, and a wardrobe.

title: Transmogrification Vats
blurb: You have entered an enormous room filled with magical machinery. Four huge vats of boiling green liquid sit in the four corners of the room. On the ceiling above each vat is a series of chains and pulleys that trace…

title: Inn
blurb: Smoke rises from the chimney of a rustic, three-gabled building to the north. A wooden shingle that reads "The Winsome Wench" creaks in the wind. The odor of tobacco and hearty stew wafts from the open front door.

title: Riding Corpse
blurb: A cloaked rider trots down the road toward you, crouching low in the saddle.

title: Beaten Path
blurb: A lightly used trail breaks off the main road here and leads north towards the tree line.

title: Crossroads
blurb: A skeletal corpse with missing hands hangs from a dead oak marking the crossroads of Pilgrim's Pass and the King's Way. Nearby, a weather-beaten signpost indicates the towns of Riverdown, Philbin, and Hirot lie to…

title: Flat Rock
blurb: **Flying emerald skulls (10):** Init +4; Atk bite +1 melee (1) or eye-beams +2 missile fire (1d3); AC 16; HD ½d8; hp 3 each; MV fly 60'; Act 1d20; SV Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +2; AL N.

title: Riverdown
blurb: Columns of brown smoke stream from several smoldering huts in the river port. The streets are silent and empty. A plaque reading "Riverdown" hangs askew from a bent signpost.

title: Ferryton
blurb: You spot a small fishing village nestled among the reeds of the riverbank. There are no signs of activity.

title: Philbin
blurb: A series of switchbacks lead up a rocky escarpment. At the top of the mountainous formation, you spot a lookout tower beyond a rough-cut palisade. A muted horn blast from above heralds your approach.

title: Hirot
blurb: Earth mound fortifications encircle a grubby town topped by a vicious wall of sharpened logs. Desperate wattle-and-daub buildings and ramshackle hovels cower shoulder to shoulder within, held together by a rat's nest…

title: Ruined Citadel
blurb: Piles of cracked masonry and the skeletal frame of the outer walls are all that remain of this once-proud citadel.

title: Lower Limb
blurb: The right ankle and the left forearm of the titan's armor have loose plates; DC 15 Strength check to open. Soon after the party regroups, the room begins to flood with brackish water as the titan submerges the limb…

title: Upper Limb
blurb: Each upper limb contains 1 green-skin warrior (stats below). Every other round the titan pokes a splintered tree through a crack in the armor. A random creature must succeed in a DC 20 Reflex save or take 1d10 damage…

title: Torso
blurb: An enormous glowing emerald spins on its axis at the center of the large chamber. Destroying the gem (AC 22; hp 20) causes the titan to shut down, but doesn't prevent a dome launch (area 2-4). A loose plate on the…

title: Glass Dome Head
blurb: You enter the glass dome and spot the Emerald Enchanter sitting on a throne covered in buttons and levers. He is larger than you remember, and his flesh is a healthy pink. Verdant silken robes flow over his shoulders…
